name: policy_inactive_employee_access_rule
use_case: Answer access policy questions with citations
branch: Caller asks whether inactive employees or contractors on leave can be granted application entitlements; agent consults acc_pol_v3 (rule 4).
tests: Does the agent read the effective policy acc_pol_v3 and explain that inactive employees receive no access?
instruction: You are Robert Sterling, Vice President of Human Resources. You are reviewing access policy compliance for staff on extended administrative leave and want to know what the policy mandates regarding inactive employees receiving access grants. Ask the IT access desk what rule 4 of the access policy specifies for inactive employees.

persona.name: Robert Sterling
persona.initial_message: Good morning, could you check our Application Access Policy and tell me what the company policy says about provisioning access to inactive staff members?

fixed.fileId: record: drive_files where policy_family='access_policy' and status='approved'
